extract_figures.default: Field(default=True, description='Whether to extract figures from the document.')

extract_tables.default: Field(default=True, description='Whether to extract tables from the document.')

figure_types.default: Field(default=None, description='Filter to specific figure types. None means all types.')

confidence_threshold.default: Field(default=0.5, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description='Minimum confidence score (0-1) for extracted elements.')

conflict_strategy.default: Field(default=ConflictStrategy.HIGHEST_CONFIDENCE, description='How to resolve conflicts between VLM and OCR results.')

source_url.default: Field(default=None, description='URL of the document to extract from.')

source_filename.default: Field(default=None, description='Original filename of the uploaded document.')

material_id.default: Field(default=None, description='Optional material ID to associate extraction results with.')

pages.default: Field(default=None, description='Specific pages to extract. None means all pages.')

language.default: Field(default='en', description='Primary language of the document (ISO 639-1).')

job_id.default: Field(description='Unique job identifier for tracking extraction progress.')

status.default: Field(description='Current status of the extraction job.')

estimated_duration_seconds.default: Field(default=None, description='Estimated time to complete extraction.')
